protocol.oracle: sim/pick_place.py PickPlace, unchanged (HERO side grasp, phases, touch logic, success criterion)
protocol.trials: trials 0-19 of sim.m1_pick_mug.trials() = M1's results/m1_pick random_00-09 + results/m1_pick_extended random_00-09 (same layouts, asserted)
protocol.cup_yaw: R0-R2: 0 deg (round, no handle; as in M1); R3: the trial's handle yaw from trials() (= results/m1_pick_mug, asserted)
protocol.steps: R0 -> R1 isolates size (diameter and height), R1 -> R2 isolates mass, R2 -> R3 isolates the handle
protocol.lift_frame: first control step of the oracle's 'lift' phase (hand fully closed after the 0.5 s close hold, lift reference just started, palm not yet risen); contacts = data.contact after that step (its last 1 ms substep)
protocol.contact_rule: by geom pair in data.contact: right-hand geom -> its body (thumb_0/1/2 = thumb, index_0/1 = index, middle_0/1 = middle, palm_link = palm); object = any geom of the cup body; grasp contact = thumb AND (index OR middle) AND palm
protocol.lift_slip: PickPlace lift_slip_in_hand_cm x 10 (cup displacement relative to the palm over the lift), mean (the spec's number) and median over trials that reached the end of the lift; over_lift_slip_limit = trials above LIFT_SLIP_FAIL_M = 20 mm (sim/pick_place.py)
protocol.lift_rise: PickPlace lift_cup_rise_cm (cup centre rise over the 10 cm palm lift), mean and median over trials that reached the end of the lift
protocol.substep_sensitivity: information only: the same contact rule read after each of the lift frame's 20 substeps of 1 ms; any = grasp contact in at least one substep, all = in every substep. Contacts flicker between substeps, so the last-substep count is a snapshot
protocol.success: cup tilt < 10 deg, cup centre within coaster radius (5 cm), resting on the coaster (|dz| < 4 mm), robot never fell

m1_failure_categories.reach: palm could not reach the target
m1_failure_categories.place: released but not on the coaster
